test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the statements is correct about a compression ignition engine?

options.text: Initial and maintenance costs of diesel engine is less compared to petrol engine.
Operating speed range is less compared to petrol engine.
Diesel engine produces less noise compared to petrol engine.
Starting is easy for diesel engine since less cranking effort is required compared to petrol engine.

solution:
The correct answer is __Operating speed range is less compared to petrol engine**(Option 2)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compression ignition engines__ are commonly referred to as diesel engines.
 
• Diesel engines operate at a lower speed range compared to petrol engines.
 
• The operating speed range is attributed to the combustion process and engine design.
 
• Diesel engines utilize high compression ratios to ignite the fuel-air mixture.
 
• While diesel engines are more efficient and durable, they typically have higher initial and maintenance costs compared to petrol engines.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Characteristics of Diesel Engines:**

 
 
• Diesel engines tend to produce more noise compared to petrol engines.
 
• Starting a diesel engine requires more cranking effort due to the higher compression ratios.
 
 
 
• **Fuel Efficiency: **
 
 
• Diesel engines are known for their better fuel efficiency and torque output.
 
• 
• They are widely used in heavy-duty applications such as trucks and buses.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Diesel engines are commonly used in industrial, agricultural, and transportation sectors.
 
• They are preferred for long-distance travel and heavy load carrying.
